result.releaseSummary: This release introduces a floating agent companion feature with personal conversational context, including a greeting that uses the authenticated user's profile name (never browser-supplied identity). The backend strictly enforces admin/editor access and same-origin checks for all companion API routes. The agent's conversational context is now constructed using the authenticated profile, and test coverage ensures that only server-authenticated names are used. The release includes new and updated tests for these flows, as well as documentation and visual evidence for desktop and iPhone. Physical Android device QA is explicitly waived by admin directive, with a follow-up ticket filed. No schema, environment, or data-store changes outside the companion preferences store. No unrelated refactors detected.
